author: Daily_CyberSec
text:
An MLflow vulnerability, CVE-2026-116690, is exploited in the wild as proof-of-concept code for it and RCE flaw CVE-2026-116692 goes public. Patch now.

#MLflow #AISecurity #MLOps #CVE2026116690 #CVE2026116692 #PoC #ActiveExploitation #RCE
https://t.co/sNDghuwvZs

author: TuringCyberObs
text:
CVE-2026-112353 affects GFI KerioConnect Webmail

Stored XSS is actively exploited in the wild and can steal credentials, session tokens and mailbox data when a malicious SVG attachment is opened

Analysis:
https://t.co/gwP52bSVNH

#CyberSecurity #EmailSecurity #IdentitySecurity

author: QuestJAS
text: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud https://t.co/2iAXrLZxOW

author: cloudsa
text: Warp's breach hit agent decision logs (prompts, reasoning steps, tool calls, command output) via a third-party vendor; about 1% of ~800,000 users affected. OpenCode lost stored OpenAI, Anthropic and Google API keys.

author: daniiie7
text: git on macOS still trusts the compromised eMudhra certs; Apple was told Oct 17. A man in the middle can fake GitHub for clone or pull and grab your token. Apple git and Homebrew git 2.56 affected.

author: FrontierSigHQ
text: The Federal Election Commission took its electronic filing system offline Monday night after someone tried to breach its systems.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical GoAhead flaw allows revoked certificates to bypass authentication. A critical vulnerability in the GoAhead embedded web server causes revoked client certificates to remain valid on certain mutual TLS deployments. Tracked as CVE-2026-115881.

author: H4ckmanac
text: Animate Co., Ltd. confirmed a data breach affecting newsletter subscribers following a cyberattack on third-party email platform Cuenote FC, operated by YMIRLINK.

author: bigrkg
text:
I'VE NEVER SEEN A MONTH LIKE THIS 🚨

Black October so far, every incident in one place 👇

Hosting and Secrets
• Railway env vars read, some decrypted
• Wallets with keys on Railway drained, ~$371k per @tayvano_ (Railway hasn't confirmed the link)
• Zeabur lost 3.2M env var https://t.co/C3Yqf64Tcg

author: BRuteLogic
text: LLM injection PoC, second-order injection fetched at inference time: an agent running the injected command turns prompt injection into RCE.

author: MCPScores
text: Critical vulnerability in MCP server io.github.zhouxiaoka/autoclip-mcp (CVE-2026-112393). A fixed version is available.

author: 2Workly
text: Active exploitation observed for Oracle EBS flaw CVE-2026-101767 (CVSS 9.8). Attackers target /OA_HTML/AppsTCFServer to chain SQLi into RCE. Block the path in your URL firewall and monitor $APPLPTMP.

author: CCBalert
text: Multiple vulnerabilities patched in WatchGuard Fireware OS, including CVE-2026-103594 (CVSS 9.5) stack buffer overflow, exposing systems to denial of service and remote code execution.

author: Sitecombhq
text: Bricksforge (WordPress plugin) has a critical flaw, CVE-2026-85097, exploited since 7 Oct: an unauthenticated upload runs code on the site. Update to 4.0.1, then check for planted files.

author: bug_pwn
text: CVE-2026-116014 in open62541 (OPC UA, CVSS 9.2): a 16-bit size counter overflows while building custom DataTypes; malicious server causes client heap overflow leading to RCE. Fixed in 1.5.7.

author: zoomeyebot
text: Langflow MCP stdio command injection lets any authenticated user run shell commands (CVE-2026-105740). Critical. 19.2k exposed instances identified.

author: 2Workly
text: Adobe patched 8 critical flaws in Campaign Classic (CVSS up to 9.9), including OS code injection CVE-2026-104353. Update to build 9403 to prevent RCE.

author: 7zSushi
text: EDK II CVE-2026-97631: a critical (CVSS v4 9.5) memory-corruption bug in PXE network boot in the UEFI firmware base most server vendors use. It lets code run before Secure Boot.

author: TraffAlex
text: Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) Node.js flaw has moved from proof of concept to active exploitation; scanning is already running.

author: BXAR_Sec
text: Google Threat Intelligence Group: 50% of likely AI-discovered vulnerabilities led to remote code execution, against 26% for other CVEs. Monthly CVE disclosures roughly doubled in 2026.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Trojanized LiteLLM 1.107.0 pushed to PyPI and Docker on Oct 21 hooks Python startup to steal credentials; the supply chain attack traced to a months-old unrotated key that gave attackers full CI/CD control.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Two MCP clients fixed sign-in flaws that let a malicious MCP server run commands on your machine: MCP Inspector (update to 2.12.0, or 1.0.3 on the 1.x line) and OpenCode on Windows/WSL (1.18.33+). Neither fix has a CVE.

author: sjandfun
text: Check Point found fake 'GPT-6 Astra' and 'Claude Opus' desktop apps on GitHub pages ranking in Google search; each bundles a real signed OpenAI or Claude installer with a malicious crypto-miner payload.

author: GlazeScanHQ
text: CVE-2026-115413 (High): AWS API MCP Server accepted auth tokens issued to other apps in the same account. Fixed in 1.6.0.

author: immunisense
text: PingCAP TiDB Cloud breach started with one compromised GitHub account; the attacker used keys and tokens in private repos and Terraform state to get into Google Cloud, Jira and internal chat (per NebuSec).

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Telegram: researcher Saifeldeen Aziz presents new 0-click sticker flaws and code execution on iOS at OffensiveCon Japan.

author: AiRiskBytes
text: From first contact to privileged cloud access in under three hours; the attacker was a fleet of agents. Microsoft named the actor behind the ConnectWise supply-chain attack: a China-aligned group running ARTEX, an open-source AI pen-testing framework.

author: PexlensX
text: LiteLLM v1.107.0 was compromised on PyPI. Attackers hijacked the release pipeline and pointed it at a lookalike repo Berri-AI/litellm.

author: nullptr_sh
text: opencode on Windows/WSL: a remote MCP server can RCE you during OAuth. No CVE. Fixed in 1.18.33; affected 1.0.137-1.18.32.

author: Rachidmarcil
text: 3 open-source MCP servers let agents be tricked into running shell commands via command injection: esp-mcp (CVE-2026-117567), Kali-GPT (CVE-2026-117569) and hagent.

author: FelipeDaragon
text:
Dark October isn't over yet... 😅

🚨 Node2Shell (CVE-2026-111497) — CVSS 9.2 CRITICAL

Researchers have now demonstrated RCE on unmodified Node.js builds, including x86-64, with ASLR enabled. Exploit attempts have also been observed in the wild, and CISA has added it to its KEV

author: atikbytes
text: If you run an MLflow tracking server, upgrade to 3.17.0. CVE-2026-116692 (CVSS 9.8): on a default no-auth server, anyone can upload a .py file as a run artifact and get the server to run it through the third-party scorer endpoint.

author: DFIR_Radar
text:
Aokigahara infostealer adds purpose-built collection routines targeting local AI coding assistants, marking a commodity malware shift that turns developer workstations into cloud and pipeline pivot points.

Key findings:

- Aokigahara (also tracked as Aoki, with possible lineage https://t.co/SgnaydvR0v

author: Dekrov_Dev
text: 42 real GitHub repositories weaponized with AI-tool autorun hooks; JFrog found malicious triggers for Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor and VS Code.

author: SendTechtimes
text: JFrog identified compromised repositories carrying developer-tool execution hooks and concealed payloads, with stolen credentials linking npm releases to further repository attacks.

author: 2k_115
text: CVE-2026-35273: Critical Oracle PeopleSoft flaw (CVSS 9.8). Unauthenticated SSRF leads to RCE. Exploited as a zero-day by ShinyHunters since May, hitting universities hard. Patch now and don't rely only on WAFs.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI-assisted extortion operation n0n hit 93 victims, demanded $283.7M total, and ran its entire attack toolkit through an LLM coding agent.

author: NewsTongueX
text: Bithumb, South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange, disclosed a breach of its internal employee mobile system; no crypto funds reported lost. 38K Daishin customers hit in a Seoul cyber wave.

author: WuRichard_
text: NVIDIA count across 31,132 agent skills: 26.1% vulnerable, 5.2% likely malicious intent.
